policy: Every frontend local/Netlify build runs the required source and emitted-output gates in release-checks.mjs. The additional tiers below are required when their change triggers apply; a fast build does not satisfy them. Record command, candidate SHA/working-source identity, environment, result and artifact path. Missing prerequisites, failures and unexpected skips are blockers, not passes.

nativeDatabase.when: Money, shared wallet, checkout, refund, provider or transaction changes
nativeDatabase.evidence: Fresh native PostgreSQL; independent-connection lock, retry and rollback tests; no live payments

nativeDatabase.when: Wallet, pack purchase, banner, journal or collection changes
nativeDatabase.evidence: Native wallet/collection concurrency, exact retry intent and rollback

nativeDatabase.when: Wallet, daily/monthly reward or account eligibility changes
nativeDatabase.evidence: Native account reward persistence, idempotency and calendar boundaries

nativeDatabase.when: Wallet, ranked settlement, room lifecycle or reward cap changes
nativeDatabase.evidence: Native settlement/cap concurrency and same-claim retry

nativeDatabase.when: Online synchronization, persisted replay, room rules compatibility, retirement, settlement or Kumite cancellation changes
nativeDatabase.evidence: Fresh native conditional polling, compact and legacy replay, authorization, retirement, settlement exclusion and concurrent recovery; distinct from real-network browser proof

nativeDatabase.when: Any SQL, schema, native migration, or deployment migration changes
nativeDatabase.evidence: Fresh native development and Netlify migration histories, transaction/replay verification

nativeDatabase.when: Friendships, blocking, invitations, online lobby access or social row-lock changes
nativeDatabase.evidence: Fresh native independent-connection social mutation and authorization checks

nativeDatabase.when: Inbox grants, broadcast delivery, mailbox ownership or receipt concurrency changes
nativeDatabase.evidence: Fresh native broadcast claim/retry/ownership coverage; generic embedded mail cases are additional evidence

nativeDatabase.when: Events, feedback, patch delivery, outbox or API startup changes
nativeDatabase.evidence: Full fresh native event/feedback and outbox suite, separate from migration-only replay

nativePrerequisites: Run unprivileged with PostgreSQL initdb, pg_ctl and postgres installed
Unset DATABASE_URL so each command owns a fresh loopback cluster
Never substitute PGlite for native concurrency/transaction evidence

browser.when: Store, checkout, wallet or account changes
browser.server: Starts its isolated payment fixture on PAYMENT_E2E_PORT (default 4319)
browser.evidence: Real component/provider UI with deterministic mocked HTTP; no live checkout

browser.when: Any economy, account, journal, counter or navigation changes
browser.server: TRAINING_REVIEW_URL for purchase/market (default localhost:4319); REVIEW_BASE_URL for Corner (4319); UI_ORIGIN for FinishCounter (4245). Use a full local Vite fixture server.
browser.evidence: Exact intent/key, account isolation, late response and foreign-pending journal recovery; mocked HTTP is not transaction proof

browser.when: Wallet, notifications, daily/monthly rewards or popup blockers change
browser.server: UI_ORIGIN (default localhost:4245); local fixture server with complete assets
browser.evidence: Responsive, reduced-motion, receipt/dismissal and shared notification semantics

browser.when: Pack/reveal, film, media, sound or scene lifecycle changes
browser.server: UI_ORIGIN and runner-specific URL overrides; full Vite fixtures/assets
browser.evidence: Actual media/print rendering, hidden/error/reduced lifecycle, desktop/phone recorded handoff; run one GPU/browser workload at a time

browser.when: Shared CSS, battle layout, rendering or animation changes
browser.server: Use harness production-build instructions and unchanged thresholds
browser.evidence: Same workload, viewport, cache and renderer; preserve baseline and trace; not physical-device proof

browser.when: Online/PvE rules compatibility, checkpoint/completion recovery or challenge restart changes
browser.server: PvE: UI_ORIGIN with full local Vite fixtures. Online: ONLINE_RULES_ORIGIN (default localhost:4337), standard Vite BASE_PATH=/squabblemon/ and VITE_E2E_AUTH=true; ONLINE_RULES_BASE_PATH must match.
browser.evidence: Real PlayLoop checkpoint/completion409 with preserved challengeRunId and responsive restart; actual Multiplayer retirement focus, 44px reachable recovery and full document navigation across friend/ranked/Kumite. Intercepted local HTTP/destination documents are not real two-client network or authenticated destination proof.

browser.when: Onboarding, tutorial, saved decks, coach targeting or shared navigation changes
commands: pnpm exec playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts e2e/deck-journey.spec.ts --project=chromium-desktop --project=chromium-phone
browser.server: Deck suite owns STORY_TEST_PORT; rookie runner owns ROOKIE_PORT (default4197), with CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE override. Both require full local assets.
browser.evidence: Actual responsive app, saved-deck state/history and one guided battle replayed through the shared verifier; mocked HTTP is not native reward transaction proof

browser.when: Worker computation, local battle orchestration or snapshot message changes
browser.server: Owns an isolated Vite server and Chromium; run sequentially with other performance browser work
browser.evidence: Actual module worker and same-input full engine parity, responsive event loop, bounded worker input; no physical-device or production thermal proof

browser.when: Story content, chapter index, delivery, cache or retry changes
browser.server: Owns isolated port4193; phone and desktop real Story components with mocked account API
browser.evidence: Chapter network isolation, cached revisit, deep links, retry, stale revision and cancellation; exact generated content checked separately

browserPrerequisites: Installed compatible Playwright browsers; configure CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE or runner-specific executable variable when required
Use isolated fixture/local endpoints; no production accounts or purchases
Preserve screenshots/JSON/video and actual viewport/cache/renderer details
A fixture pass does not satisfy real two-client staging, physical phone, screen-reader or interrupted-network release journeys
manualAndHosted: Authenticated staging sign-in -> play -> reward -> revisit with exact wallet values
Two real clients: reconnect, update/version mismatch and interrupted network
Physical phone/tablet touch, keyboard-only, text enlargement, screen-reader and reduced-motion journeys
Only call a revision deployed after hosting reports matching ready commit; this inventory never deploys
